resource.title:
Complete the NotebookLM integration to make it act as an extension of the local Virtual File System (VFS).
Specific goals:
1. Extract names and metadata for both Sources and Studio Outputs (Notes, Audio Overviews, etc.) within a notebook.
2. For Studio Outputs, implement the ability to download their actual content (text for notes, audio for overviews).
3. Implement the ability to modify uploaded sources and move them between different notebooks.

Update the TypeScript client in `agents/rsrch/src/notebooklm-client.ts` and the CLI commands in `agents/rsrch/src/commands/notebooklm.ts` to support these new features. You can use the mock HTML files (like `agents/rsrch/mocks/notebooklm-finDerivates.html`) to understand the current NotebookLM DOM structure for Playwright interactions. Ensure the changes are committed and pushed to a new branch for review.
